thread:
tara-marketing: Heads up — launching next week and we need a "sticky" asset pack for the campaign and webinar. Compact set: hero slide, single-slide benchmark primer, 6 technical microcards, and 15 social variants (various sizes). We want Figma components + PNG/SVG exports and a short animated GIF for the hero. Localize EN/ES/JP. Can design take this?

nina-design: Yes, we can handle it. Need exact deliverables and a hard priority list. Any constraints on copy length or animation?

tara-marketing: Priority order: 1) hero slide (for landing + webinar banner) 2) benchmark primer (one slide with a simple sparkline + bullet points) 3) six microcards: cache, batching, kv-cache, quantization, routing tiers, graceful fallback 4) social variants (15) across 1200x628, 1080x1080, 820x312. Deadline: Tue EOD (5 days). Keep visuals minimal, single-accent usage, and align with brand tokens.

cal-creative: Style notes: use flat geometric icons, subtle grain texture on hero background, and a 2-frame micro-animation for the hero (fade + token sparkle). I'll prototype the GIF frames.

nina-design: Technical export spec I propose:
```
- Hero: 1600x900 @1x and @2x PNG, GIF 800x450 (short loop), Figma slide with speaker placeholder
- Benchmark primer: 1200x628 PNG + PDF slide, editable sparkline layer
- Microcards: 800x800 and 1200x628 exports, SVG icon set, copy locked to 10w headline / 18w body
- Social: PNGs + one 640x360 MP4 teaser for each hero variant
- File naming: campaign_sticky_<asset>_<locale>_v1.<ext>
```
Is that OK?

devin-solutions: For the technical cards, please avoid numbers implying SLA. Use labels like "typical latency" or "lower cost tier". I'll loop in eng-ml for quick checks on terminology and diagram accuracy.

samir-product: Copy guidance: For the primer, phrase bullets as benefit-focused: "Reduces per-token cost", "Improves median latency" — avoid absolutes. I'll supply final copy tomorrow AM. Add a tiny footnote: "Performance varies by model and workload."

brandbot: Brand rules: primary palette #0A2540 (dark), #0B6FFF (blue), #14D1A1 (green). Use Redwood Sans family. Ensure body color contrast >= 4.5:1. Use spacing tokens: s-8 / s-16 for paddings. No unapproved fonts.

nina-design: Great. Filename convention confirmed: `campaign_sticky_<asset>_<locale>_v1.<ext>`. Owners: Nina - design lead; Cal - motion/creative; Samir - copy; Devin - eng review; Tara - campaign owner + final signoff.

cal-creative: I'll drop two motion frames and an example GIF in the Figma file tonight.

devin-solutions: I'll review the microcard wording once drafts are in, likely pinging eng-ml for one small accuracy pass.

tara-marketing: Please tag me in Figma when first pass is ready. Also, we need social-ready CTA variations (Register, Learn more, See benchmark) — keep them short.

nina-design: Roger. I'll add CTA tokens and localization notes. Expect first pass (hero + primer + 2 microcards) by EOD tomorrow.

tara-marketing: Thanks team 680. If anything blocks, call out ASAP.
